questions.question: What question did Job raise about being righteous before God?
options: Where can a man flee from God's sight?
How can a man be in the right before God?
Who can stand when the Lord is angry?
Why does the wicked man so often go unpunished?
questions.answer: How can a man be in the right before God?

questions.question: How did Job describe God's power?
options: He removes mountains and commands the sun
He is weak before the forces of nature
He is limited and cannot act freely
He is distant and far removed from all men
questions.answer: He removes mountains and commands the sun

questions.question: Job wished for an arbiter (umpire) to stand between him and God.
Job said God is wise in heart and mighty in _____.
Job said even if he were innocent, his own mouth would _____ him.
